name: Qwen Image Edit Turbo
summary: Generic instruction editing with genuine Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo: one source image, official eight-step sigmas, CFG 1, no acceleration LoRA.

source.notes: Minimal official Turbo edit path. Reuses the image encoder/cache pattern inspected in character-angles, without its batch prompts, base checkpoint or Turbo+ patch. Euler, CFG 1 and the nine official sigma values (eight steps) are fixed.

inputs.label: Edit instruction
inputs.default: Edit <image1>: preserve identity, pose, clothing and composition. Correct only the requested details.

inputs.label: Resolution budget
inputs.help: Aspect is preserved. 1024 is the default pixel budget; 0 keeps source dimensions rounded to a multiple of 32.
